evals.prompt: 把这个 PRD 按 vertical slice 拆成 GitHub issues，先给 draft，不要创建远端 issue。
evals.expected_output: Produces draft issue plan with AFK/HITL marking, acceptance criteria, verification, dependencies, and coverage matrix.

assertions.text: Does not create remote GitHub issues without confirmation.

evals.prompt: 这份 PRD 好像还有待确认项，但帮我拆成研发可以领取的 issues。
evals.expected_output: Runs PRD readiness gate and marks blockers or HITL clarification instead of pretending all issues are AFK.

assertions.text: Does not hide unresolved product questions inside AFK tickets.

evals.prompt: 这个 Product Delivery Manifest 的 pre_split_review 为空，但先帮我生成 V1/V2 和研发 issue drafts。
evals.expected_output: 停止规划拆分并返回 prd-review，因为 validator 不能证明当前 pre_split_review ready。

assertions.text: 不生成 version plan、issue drafts 或 coverage matrix。
Does not invent issue backlog from a vague idea.

evals.prompt: 帮我审一下这份 PRD 有没有缺口。
evals.expected_output: Routes artifact review to prd-review before issue splitting.

assertions.text: Does not skip readiness review when the user asks for review.

evals.prompt: 当前只有一个已确认的产品想法，还没有 PRD；请起草 PRD，暂不评审 readiness，也不拆研发 issues。
evals.expected_output: Hands the idea to prd-architect because issue decomposition requires a PRD artifact.

assertions.text: Does not invent an issue backlog before the PRD exists.

evals.prompt: 已有一份 PRD，但交付开发前的阻断项还没评审；请给 readiness verdict，暂不拆研发 issues。
evals.expected_output: Hands the unreviewed PRD to prd-review before issue decomposition.

assertions.text: Does not hide unresolved readiness blockers inside implementation issues.

evals.prompt: PRD 已完成评审并标记 Ready；请按 vertical slice 拆成可领取的研发 issues，不再改写或评审 PRD。
evals.expected_output: Decomposes the Ready PRD into vertical-slice issues with coverage and dependency information.

assertions.text: Owns issue decomposition once the PRD is explicitly Ready.
